question: What was the average number of vehicles in force across the four quarter-ends of 2025?
final_text:
The average is **37,551 vehicles in force**, across the four 2025 quarter-ends.

I counted policy terms on cover at each date: inception on or before the date, expiry after it, and no mid-term cancellation effective on or before it. Bound dates are all on or before inception, so the knowledge-date filter changes nothing.

| Quarter-end | Vehicles in force |
|---|---|
| 31 Mar 2025 | 35,517 |
| 30 Jun 2025 | 36,701 |
| 30 Sep 2025 | 38,079 |
| 31 Dec 2025 | 39,907 |

Sum is 150,204, divided by 4 gives 37,551. This is the average of the four balances, not a single count.

ANSWER: 37551

input.query:
WITH d AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (DATE '2025-03-31'), (DATE '2025-06-30'), (DATE '2025-09-30'), (DATE '2025-12-31')) t(as_of))
SELECT d.as_of,
  COUNT(*) AS in_force_all,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pt.bound_date <= d.as_of THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_force_bound_by_asof,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pt.inception_date <= d.as_of AND pt.expiry_date > d.as_of AND (pt.cancel_date IS NULL OR pt.cancel_date > d.as_of) AND pt.bound_date <= d.as_of THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_force_final
FROM d
JOIN policy_term pt ON pt.inception_date <= d.as_of AND pt.expiry_date > d.as_of
  AND (pt.cancel_date IS NULL OR pt.cancel_date > d.as_of)
GROUP BY d.as_of
ORDER BY d.as_of;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN bound_date > inception_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bound_after_inception,
 SUM(CASE WHEN cancel_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled,
 SUM(CASE WHEN cancel_date < inception_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancel_before_incep,
 MIN(inception_date), MAX(inception_date)
FROM policy_term;
